chapters.label: The final, live
chapters.text: Moscow, 2018: the World Cup final. The referee checks the video. Penalty to France! The keeper takes his time. Antoine Griezmann runs in, pauses... and rolls it in. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. A calm run-up, then a pause. He watches Subašić move first... and rolls it the other way.

chapters.label: The wrong way
chapters.text: From the goal line: the keeper dives one way, the ball goes the other! France go on to be world champions!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Keep your run-up calm. Watch the keeper. If he moves, strike the other side with confidence!
